selectedIdea.angle: Show what the evidence says about cassini.

synthesis.factHandoff: Cassini released Huygens toward Titan. Its primary mission ended in June 2008 and operations continued through September 2017.

narrative.content:
Kern van het verhaal
Met de afronding van de primaire missie in 2008 stopten de operaties van Cassini.

Redactionele insteek
Licht dit feit in gewone taal toe.
